summary: Backend regression + new-feature testing for iteration 28 (no-show detection + video-call access gating). 18 tests, all pass. Covered: (1) video-token endpoint returns 425/too_early when now < start-20min and 410/session_closed when now > close_at; (2) videocall-magic endpoint returns 425, 410 with role_hint='paziente', and 403 on invalid token; (3) daily_service.create_room_for_appointment + create_meeting_token use nbf = start - 20min (verified by intercepting the httpx payload with a stub); (4) no_show_service.run_no_show_check produces the correct outcome (OUTCOME_NONE with empty presenze; OUTCOME_NO_TER when only patient attended), persists a seduta_logs snapshot, marks appuntamenti.stato + outcome, is idempotent on no_show_notified_at; (5) booking_service.schedule_reminders registers 3 additional APScheduler jobs with ids noshow-final-{id}/noshow-post-{id}/noshow-24h-{id}; (6) booking_service._ensure_videocall_magic_token sets videocall_magic_expires = start + 15 min; (7) admin/seduta-logs returns {items,count}, honours filters (outcome, terapeuta_id, from_date, to_date), and returns 403 for paziente/terapeuta; (8) appuntamenti/{id}/presenze prefers snapshot source over live, forbids paziente; (9) all 5 no-show email templates return False (no raise) when SEND_EMAILS=false, and their signatures accept the documented ctx dict.
critical_code_review_comments: no_show_service._match_participant does a two-way substring match (target in name OR name in target). With target list ['','paziente'] this could produce a false positive on any user_name containing 'paziente'. Currently guarded because patient full name is prepended and empty targets are skipped, but consider tightening to strict substring-of-name-only or exact-match-after-normalisation to remove the ambiguity.

no_show_service.run_no_show_check: idempotency is enforced on the email-dispatch side (no_show_notified_at guard), but _mark_appointment_outcome is called every run — safe because it's a $set with the same value, but note that a manual admin change to stato (other than the guarded completato/cancellato) would be overwritten on the next scheduled run (start+durata+15 / +24h with is_final=False DO NOT call _mark, so this is fine — worth a comment).

routers/appuntamenti.py::videocall_magic — role_hint hard-codes 'paziente'. Correct today since magic links are patient-facing, but if the flow is later extended to therapists, this will silently mislead the frontend.

routers/appuntamenti.py::get_video_token — the close window is start + durata + 15 min, while the magic-link window is start + 15 min. This is intentional (logged-in users can rejoin mid-session) but the divergence deserves a docstring so future readers don't 'fix' it into consistency.

booking_service.schedule_reminders — no-show scheduling is wrapped in try/except but does not remove already-scheduled jobs if the reminder loop is called again with a different data_ora (reschedule). APScheduler replace_existing=True is set on the no-show jobs (good) but note that the OTHER jobs (rem1d, rem1h, sms30m, rem15m, review) also use replace_existing=True — so overall behaviour is idempotent per app_id. OK.

email_service SEND_EMAILS gate: only send_no_show_admin_alert falls through to _send_raw which does the gate; the four patient/terapist templates all delegate to _send_raw too — good, verified in test.
test_credentials: Admin: hr@funzionabene.it / @Bidoc2026! (working). demo.paziente@funzionabene.it and demo.terapeuta@funzionabene.it are ABSENT in current preview DB — tests seed their own users (test_noshow_paz_* / test_noshow_ter_*) and clean up.
seed_data_creation: Session fixture creates one test paziente + terapeuta (users + pazienti + terapisti + informed_consent granted) marked with test_seed=true. Each test also seeds its own appuntamenti + seduta_logs rows. Teardown deletes all rows with test_seed=true + any seduta_logs with room_name starting with 'appuntamento-TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_no_show_and_video_gating.py. They require MONGO_URL/DB_NAME (loaded by conftest.py from backend/.env) and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test users are self-seeded so no dependency on demo seed data. If iteration 29+ touches JOIN_OPEN_BEFORE_MIN / JOIN_CLOSE_AFTER_MIN or the seduta_logs schema, re-run this file first — it's the fastest signal.
